candidate_contract.signature: int32 clif_send(const void* buf, int32 len, const block_list* bl, enum send_target type)
candidate_contract.statement: Under the exact reviewed profile and stated unresolved assumptions, clif_emotion supplies the address of its live local PACKET_ZC_EMOTION p and compiler-measured sizeof(p)=7 to clif_send AREA. The expanded sink does not rebind buf or len, derives recipient destinations from session FIFO state, and passes the original buf/len to its recursive SELF and AREA variadic callback path. Reached memcpy sites copy len bytes from supplied buffer to per-session FIFO; reached WFIFOSET sites receive unchanged len. This describes copy/queue requests only, not successful queueing or receipt.

source storage does not overlap any session FIFO and remains live during synchronous enumeration
variadic pointer retrieval is valid under the actual ABI/language contract; see blocking unresolved U1
